metroCensus.method: INSEE 2022 census counts joined by IRIS code to the available IGN Contours IRIS geometry. Allocate each source unit's population over 100 m GHS-POP residential cells. census.method: Local census coverage only · City of Seattle within Seattle study boundary. Distribute small-area counts over native 100 m GHS-POP 2020 residential cells by population weight, using only their in-boundary portion. This assumes the same within-unit distribution for each group. Disability covers the civilian noninstitutionalized population. Poverty covers persons for whom poverty status is determined. Fixed ACS 2018–2022 baseline.
